Given the recommendation for a robust combination and the evidence that weighted schemes can outperform plain averages when the model rankings are unstable, B is the safest choice for generalisation.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (plain mean) has a higher overall score and slightly worse performance on the second window, indicating it is less able to adapt to the varying model strengths across windows. Therefore, B is preferred over A and C.
